name: rosenbrock_2d
title: 2D Rosenbrock Target Distribution from Pagani et al. (2022)
description: Synthetic dataset specifying a 2-dimensional target space (n1 = 2, n2 = 1) with parameters a = 0.05 and b = 5.0 for the Rosenbrock distribution. In Pagani et al. (2022), this corresponds to Model 1 and represents the baseline against which every other model is compared.
